issues.issue: Statement of Activities (p2) shows these as operating grants and contributions to public safety (79,515), senior center (33,169) and environment/leisure (2,454). Senior center and fire grants may come from governments (area agency on aging, rural fire district/county), which would make them intergovernmental/state aid or federal grants. The report does not say where they come from. The same applies to the detail lines for Fire, Pool, Park and Senior Center grants.

Statement of Activities (p3) shows governmental Insurance proceeds of 29,153 inside the fund statement's Other 48,082 (General 42,045). The General department's Other revenues line is probably mostly insurance proceeds (reimbursements/refunds), but the schedule doesn't break the line down, so other is kept.

The amount is correct as printed. The General Fund Departments schedule prints TIF 6,480 and total interest 26,014, while the fund statement (p5) and budget schedule (p9) print 6,479 and 26,015. These are 1-dollar rounding differences in the report itself, mentioned in notes but not in report_discrepancies.
